subject: Workplace Skills
title: What Your Boss Is Measured On
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on What Your Boss Is Measured On.

hook.text: A developer spent months optimizing code elegance. His boss was measured on shipping speed. He was let go.

buildup.text: Every manager is evaluated on specific metrics. Revenue, retention, delivery speed, or team satisfaction.

discovery.text: When your work directly supports your boss's key metrics, you become indispensable. Alignment creates leverage.

twist.text: Your boss may not tell you what they are measured on. You might need to infer it from their priorities.

climax.text: Ask: 'What does success look like for our team this quarter?' The answer reveals their scoreboard.

punchline.text: Know their scoreboard. Then help them win.

quiz.question: Why should you know what your boss is measured on?
options: It helps you appear busy working on the right things
Aligning your work to their metrics makes you indispensable
It gives you ammunition during performance reviews
